rows.label: qst640301_msg0001
rows.name:
I like looking over the city of Teos
Aure from high places...

rows.label: qst640301_msg0003
rows.name: I know where you were going with it...

rows.label: qst640301_msg0004
rows.name:
You're asking me, the greatest artisan
in Alst, to make an accessory from
Ripobik Ellook materials, aren't you?

rows.label: qst640301_msg0005
rows.name:
I'll head home first. Come to my house
once you've gathered the materials.

rows.label: qst640301_msg0006
rows.name: And don't make me wait too long.
